n, k = map(int, input().split())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))

# dp[i] = minimum reply chain length to reach a tweet with no replies
dp = [0] * (n + 1)
displayed = 0

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    if a[i - 1] == 0:
        dp[i] = 0
        displayed += 1
    else:
        parent = a[i - 1]
        if dp[parent] < k:
            dp[i] = dp[parent] + 1
            displayed += 1
        else:
            dp[i] = dp[parent] + 1

print(displayed)
